# Lynn component index (55 components, lynn-ui 0.1.0)

One line per component. Fetch `references/components/<Name>.md` for the full usage, don't and props before using one for the first time.

## Foundations

- `ThemeProvider` - The recommended root wrapper: renders the `.lynn-root` element every component's CSS expects and stamps `data-lynn-theme` onto it, which is what re-points the `--lynn-color-*` neutrals at a different mode.
- `ThemeToggle` - The three-way light / dark / lynn switch, modeled on the plugin's own `role="radiogroup"` theme toggle and built on `Tabs` so it inherits the segmented-control styling rather than restating it.

## Actions

- `Button` - A Lynn action button.
- `Switch` - A boolean on/off control.
- `Tabs` - A Lynn segmented control.

## Forms

- `Dropdown` - A select-style dropdown, ported from the plugin's `.color-dropdown` family: a trigger carrying the current swatch and label, and a popover list that can filter inline and group under sticky section headers.
- `SearchInput` - The icon-prefixed search field.
- `TextField` - A single-line text field whose label starts life as the placeholder.

## Navigation

- `AccessGate` - The site-wide login modal.
- `DocRail` - The documentation sidebar: a fixed 220px glass panel that collapses to a slim edge tab.
- `Footer` - The Lynn site footer: a top border, the wordmark, and a three-column link grid.
- `Nav` - The Lynn top navigation bar: 60px tall, sticky, `rgba(33,33,43,0.92)` with a 16px backdrop blur, auto-hiding on scroll-down.

## Feedback

- `Alert` - A tinted callout box.
- `Badge` - A Lynn pill badge.
- `GaugeRing` - The radial gauge, ported from the plugin's `.score-ring`: a dim track circle plus a `stroke-dasharray`-clipped arc, with the SVG rotated -90deg so the arc starts at 12 o'clock.
- `ProgressBar` - The linear progress track, ported from the plugin's `.progress-bar-bg` / `.progress-bar-fill`, plus its separate indeterminate top-of-tab bar.
- `Skeleton` - The loading placeholder: a column of shimmering rows, shown while a list's real content is still being computed.
- `Spinner` - The bordered-ring loading spinner, ported from the plugin's `.spinner`.
- `ToastViewport` - ## Props ```ts interface ToastViewportProps { /** Milliseconds before a toast auto-dismisses.
- `Tooltip` - A hover/focus tooltip.

## Layout

- `Card` - A Lynn surface card.
- `Carousel` - A one-at-a-time slide carousel for a "Featured pages" row.
- `CtaBanner` - The site's repeated promo panel: a sentence on the left, one pill CTA on the right, stacking under 720px.
- `FeatureCard` - The rich icon-tile feature card.
- `FeaturePanel` - The large narrative walkthrough panel.
- `IconCard` - The generic "icon + title + description" card.
- `ScrollArea` - A scrollable region whose scrollbar is a curve, not a straight rule.

## Motion and effects

- `CursorGlow` - `lynn/motion/cursor-glow` A 480px radial glow that trails the pointer across the whole page, composited with `mix-blend-mode: screen`.
- `Float` - `lynn/motion/float` A gentle 6px vertical bob for icons and badges, ported from roadmap.html's `@keyframes float`.
- `GlowPulse` - `lynn/motion/glow-pulse` A breathing purple/blue box-shadow halo around its children, ported from `nice-effects.css`'s `.nice-glow-pulse` (3s ease-in-out infinite).
- `GradientBackground` - `lynn/motion/gradient-shift` The brand gradient, ported byte-for-byte from nice-effects.css.
- `Hero` - The Lynn hero: full-viewport, animated brand gradient, radial vignette and three drifting orbs behind centered eyebrow / heading / subtitle / CTA slots.
- `Lightning` - `lynn/motion/plasma-lightning` A canvas plasma ball: seven filaments radiate from a central electrode, flicker via midpoint displacement, and bend toward the cursor, with drifting light motes tracing the container's edge.
- `LiquidFill` - `lynn/motion/liquid-fill` A physics-driven particle pool that splashes up, fills the container and sloshes toward the cursor on hover, then drains back on leave.
- `PulseDot` - `lynn/motion/pulse` A status dot with an expanding-ring pulse, ported from roadmap.html's `.phase-dot.active` / `@keyframes pulse`.
- `Reveal` - `lynn/motion/scroll-reveal` Fades and slides its children up 22px as they enter the viewport.
- `Sheen` - `lynn/motion/sheen` A diagonal light sweep across its children, self-contained via a `::after` layer - ported from `nice-effects.css`'s `.nice-sheen` (4.2s ease-in-out infinite).
- `ShimmerText` - `lynn/motion/shimmer` A gradient text-clip sweep across white -> blue -> lynn -> emerald, ported verbatim from lynn.html's `.gradient-word`.
- `Sparkle` - `lynn/motion/sparkle` The default (no `children`) renders Tabler's `sparkles` glyph as three separate diamonds - the same shapes the combined icon is built from, split back into their own `<path>`s - each twinkling (scale + opacity, no rotation) on its own staggered delay.

## Icons

`IconArrowRight`, `IconArrowsSort`, `IconBolt`, `IconBulb`, `IconCheck`, `IconChevronDown`, `IconChevronUp`, `IconClipboard`, `IconEye`, `IconEyeOff`, `IconLock`, `IconMoon`, `IconNiceSmile`, `IconSpark`, `IconSparkles`, `IconSun`. All `currentColor`, all `aria-hidden`, one `size` prop. Use an icon, never an emoji; it is decorative, so the meaning has to live in adjacent text or an `aria-label` on the control.
